metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from fujifilm_provia_100f (dyes and structure): Fujifilm FP-100C peel-apart instant colour film (ISO 100, 5500 K, 25 C / 90 s); spectral sensitivity and characteristic curves digitized from the Fujifilm Product Information Bulletin AF3-129E (curves nearly coincide; one shape scaled to each channel's Dmin/Dmax). Instant print approximated as a directly scanned positive: characteristic curves (reflection density read as transmission density, unmixed with the base dyes) and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet; print white tint from the datasheet minimum densities; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
